text:
alexa: Heads up — nightly eval (invoice_csv_parsing) spiked on model v3.2-merge1 at ~03:20 UTC. Failures are almost all malformed CSV / commas getting swallowed or glued to previous token. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/eval/3834567890 :frowning_face:

matt: saw the alert. quick skim — many outputs have commas attached to preceding numbers or words (e.g., `1000.00,` becomes `1000.00,` with no separator in parsed CSV). looks like token boundary behavior changed.

jia: I ran a small diff between v3.2 (baseline) and v3.2-merge1 on 20 samples. Pattern: tokenizer normalization tweak + tokenizer package bump in the same image. Command I used:```bash
./scripts/nightly_eval.py --model v3.2-merge1 --prompts data/invoice_sample_20.json --show_tokens --out ./tmp/v3.2-merge1.out```
Diff excerpt (token lists):
```
baseline tokens: ["1000", ".", "00", ",", " \"]
```
